title: Herb Infused Jamaican Tiger Prawns Skewers
description: Savory and glassy-jelly, these Jamaican tiger prawns skewers are perfect for a lazy Sunday, featuring a blend of herbs and spices in a macrobiotic-friendly dish.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine scotch bonnet peppers, thyme, allspice, garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil to make the herb infusion.
Add the herb infusion to a bowl with the tiger prawns and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated tiger prawns onto skewers.
Season the tiger prawns with salt.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the prawns are pink and cooked through.
Let the skewers rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve the herb infused Jamaican tiger prawns skewers hot.
Garnish with additional thyme if desired.
